name: SNOMED Global Patient Set (GPS)
description: The SNOMED International Global Patient Set (GPS), a flat identifier-and-term artifact. The January 2026 release includes all active SNOMED CT International Edition concepts and all concepts inactive since 2012. Each concept preserves the source ConceptID, active status, Fully Specified Name, and US Preferred Term. GPS does not contain SNOMED CT hierarchies, relationships, definitions, mappings, translations, or semantic reasoning content.
